entries.name: empty
entries.description: Schema-only baseline. No source corpus, no entities, no facts. Used as the cluster-bridging Phase 1 sanity-check snapshot and as the gating fixture for snapshot infrastructure (j77.1).
entries.notes: Schema-only LLM baseline. pg_dump --format=custom embeds a timestamp in the dump header, so byte-stable hashing is approximate; the first ensure call populates expected_hashes and subsequent runs detect drift but do not block. Larger drift indicates a migration or pg_dump flag change. Per doc 28 §10 lock B7.

entries.name: frankenstein-10chunks
entries.description: First 10 chapters of Mary Shelley's Frankenstein from Project Gutenberg eBook #84 (~144 KB). Canonical narrative cluster-bridging fixture per doc 28 §2.2. Generated by chunking the corpus at 2000-char boundaries (paragraph/newline/sentence/space, mirroring viz/js/app.js chunkText) and POSTing each chunk to /ingest/queue with the manifest's pinned Haiku model + extraction prompt + nomic-embed-text 768-dim embeddings. Per-chunk timeout 5 min.
entries.notes: Re-run when any pin changes (model version, extraction prompt version, embedding model, temperature). Stats may drift ±5% across regenerations within fixed pins; larger drift indicates a pin needs updating (cold-eyes review B7). LLM dumps already aren't deterministic so the custom-format pg_dump header timestamp is irrelevant — kept on custom format for the byte-stable hashing of structural state. expected_hashes will populate on first successful generate against the live platform + ML stack; the live smoke is gated on a running server (port 3000) + ml-services (port 8000) + Ollama (port 11434) per doc 28 §2.5.

entries.name: synthetic-1k
entries.description: 1000 deterministic synthetic entities across 5 cluster modes with 10 bridge pairs (entities pinned to different cluster modes, sharing no memories/facts/aliases). Centroids computed by the production updateEntityMeta code path. Used as the benchmark sweet-spot per doc 28 §2.2.
entries.notes: Per doc 28 §3.3: layered generation (per-memory vectors → memory_entities → updateEntityMeta computes centroids). Bridge-pair entity IDs land in ground_truth.json (invisible to algorithms — never written to entities/same_as_links). Plain-format dump + post-process strips pg_dump's wall-clock header so identical seed yields identical SHA-256.

entries.name: synthetic-10k
entries.description: 10000 deterministic synthetic entities across 5 cluster modes with 50 bridge pairs. Required for unconditional cluster-bridging phases per doc 28 §4.3 and benchmark scale ceiling per §2.2.
entries.notes: Same generator as synthetic-1k. Targets §5.1 thresholds (<30s generate, <5s load). Plain-format dump strategy as synthetic-1k.
